evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched balanced syntactic clauses ('A rollback we have not... is a rollback we do not...') creating an epigrammatic antithetical rule.

mints.name: UnpracticedCapabilityNegation
mints.title: A capability not rehearsed is a capability not had
mints.frame: Does the speaker frame readiness through a balanced epigram negating unexercised capabilities?
